newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - HANSABANK-LATVIJA H1 PROFIT 683,531 LATS.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - HANSABANK-LATVIJA H1 PROFIT 683,531 LATS.

text.p: Hansabank-Latvija, the Latvian subsidiary of Estonia's Hansapank , said on Wednesday that its first-half profit was 683,531 lats.
The bank said in a statement that its total income for the first half of the year was 10 percent more than planned.
The bank's assets at the end of June were 69.6 million lats, 6.4 million lats higher than at the end of 1996 and 2.8 million lats more than in May.
The bank said that its income from commissions was 17 percent higher than planned, which was due mainly to a 30 percent rise in incomes from currency operations.
It said that its securities portfolio rose by six million lats or 51 percent and its credit portfolio expanded by nine million lats or 81 percent.
The bank had given total credits to clients of 20.23 million lats and had current account deposits of 35.17 million lats and term deposit accounts of 14.32 million lats.
